Jon Brower Minnoch was known for being one of the heaviest individuals ever recorded, suffering from extreme obesity (weighing over 1,400 lb at his peak). Anorexia nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by self‑imposed severe restriction of food intake leading to significantly low body weight. Minnoch’s condition was the opposite—massive weight gain rather than severe weight loss—so he did not suffer from anorexia nervosa.  

**Final answer: No**
